description: Overview Ready to shape the products of tomorrow? The Product Challenge is the ultimate product design and innovation challenge where you step into the role of a Product Manager to architect the next big tech solution! Guidelines : Solve a Massive Industry Challenge: Take on real-world market friction, identify key consumer trends, and build a tech-first solution that redefines user convenience and digital trade . Define Your Vision: Identify a high-impact target segment, map out the core problem, and pitch a game-changing product concept . Craft the User Experience: Design seamless end-to-end user journeys and create stunning UX/UI mockups or wireframes that bring your product to life . Build the Tech & Business Blueprint: Lay out the tech stack (AI, IoT, or automated systems) powering your platform and construct a viable, profitable monetization strategy . Showcase Scalability & Impact: Prove technical feasibility, data privacy, and outline key performance metrics (KPIs) to show how your innovation scales globally . Pitch Your Big Idea: Package your vision into an executive 8-slide pitch deck to battle it out on the national stage ! Platform will be unstop and offline event at IIT Kanpur.

raw.details:
Overview

Ready to shape the products of tomorrow? The Product Challenge is the ultimate product design and innovation challenge where you step into the role of a Product Manager to architect the next big tech solution!

Guidelines : 

  • Solve a Massive Industry Challenge: Take on real-world market friction, identify key consumer trends, and build a tech-first solution that redefines user convenience and digital trade.
  • Define Your Vision: Identify a high-impact target segment, map out the core problem, and pitch a game-changing product concept.
  • Craft the User Experience: Design seamless end-to-end user journeys and create stunning UX/UI mockups or wireframes that bring your product to life.
  • Build the Tech & Business Blueprint: Lay out the tech stack (AI, IoT, or automated systems) powering your platform and construct a viable, profitable monetization strategy.
  • Showcase Scalability & Impact: Prove technical feasibility, data privacy, and outline key performance metrics (KPIs) to show how your innovation scales globally.
  • Pitch Your Big Idea: Package your vision into an executive 8-slide pitch deck to battle it out on the national stage!
  • Platform will be unstop and offline event at IIT Kanpur.
